title: 第2章 云影坠渊 白炎界
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

无之深渊

云澈二人坠下无之深渊后，无数道剧烈的空间风暴席卷他们二人周身。

千叶影儿的身上被空间风暴撕开了数道长长血痕。

“云澈。”

她惊呼一声，手指微动，神谕从手指指尖射出，射向云澈。

神谕缠绕在云澈周身，撕裂云澈周围的空间风暴。

千叶影儿周身也耀起了极为强烈的黑色玄光，空间风暴无法对这道黑色玄光撕裂。

云澈提醒道：“无之深渊越往下，空间风暴就越剧烈，你万分小心。”

他拥有着邪神玄脉，能够凭借自己肉身力量抵挡住空间风暴。

千叶影儿就不一样了，她很难对下方的空间风暴进行抵挡。

千叶影儿金眸之中射出一道金芒，她的声音有些沉吟道：

“深渊。”

云澈二人身躯在神谕与黑暗玄光之下，坠下深渊的速度越来越快。

一刻钟之后，席卷来的空间风暴破碎了千叶影儿周身的黑色玄光。

千叶影儿力量无法维持，守护在云澈周围的神谕也随之破碎。

云澈手掌轻轻的一挥，一个巨大的黑色玄光笼罩在他与千叶影儿身边。

空间风暴尽数被这道黑色玄光抵挡。

“啊~！”

千叶影儿从口中发出一道惨叫声，她的身躯被空间风暴击中，一滴滴鲜血从她的身上滴落而下。

云澈看着此时的她，也只好分离出自身三分之一的力量守护在千叶影儿身边。

千叶影儿说道：“云澈，你不必这样做，我能够抵挡住。”

云澈分离出来了来守护她，这是一个极其错误的决定。

云澈分离出力量，守护在他身边的力量就微弱了。

这样，就很可能两人都要葬身在深渊之中。

千叶影儿不想看到如此结果。

云澈：“千影，你

千叶影儿张开的嘴巴又闭合了起来。

云澈说出这句话，她无法说出任何反驳之语。

他们二人的身躯越来越往下，周围的空间风暴的力量也愈发强大。

一道道空间风暴贯穿云澈、千叶影儿的身躯，千叶影儿实现前方是一片的朦胧。

不一会儿，她陷入了昏迷。

“不好。”

云澈声音凝重了一分。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

abyss of nothingness

After Yun Che and the two fell into the Abyss of Nothingness, countless fierce space storms swept across the two of them.

Qianye Ying'er's body was torn apart by the space storm with several long blood marks.

"Yun Che."

She exclaimed, moved her fingers slightly, and the oracle shot out from the tips of her fingers towards Yun Che.

The oracle wrapped around Yun Che, tearing apart the spatial storm around Yun Che.

Qianye Ying'er's body also shone with an extremely strong black mysterious light, and the space storm could not tear apart this black mysterious light.

Yun Che reminded: "The further you go down into the Abyss of Nothingness, the more violent the space storm will be. You must be extremely careful."

He possesses the evil god's profound veins and can withstand space storms with the strength of his physical body.

Qianye Ying'er was different. It was difficult for her to resist the space storm below.

A golden light shot out from Qianye Ying'er's golden eyes, and she said in a somewhat thoughtful voice:

"Abyss."

Under the oracle and dark mysterious light, the two bodies of Yun Che fell into the abyss faster and faster.

A quarter of an hour later, the sweeping space storm shattered the black light around Qianye Ying'er.

Qianye Ying'er's power could not be maintained, and the oracle guarding Yun Che was also shattered.

Yun Che waved his hand gently, and a huge black mysterious light enveloped him and Qianye Ying'er.

The space storm was all blocked by this black mysterious light.

"Ah~!"

Qianye Ying'er let out a scream from her mouth, her body was hit by the space storm, and drops of blood dripped from her body.

Yun Che looked at her at this moment and had no choice but to use one-third of his power to guard Qianye Ying'er.

Qianye Ying'er said: "Yun Che, you don't have to do this, I can resist it."

Yun Che separated himself to protect her, which was an extremely wrong decision.

Yun Che separated his power, and the power guarding him became weaker.

In this way, it is very likely that both of them will be buried in the abyss.

Qianye Ying'er didn't want to see such a result.

Yun Che: "Qianying, you

Qianye Ying'er's open mouth closed again.

When Yun Che said these words, she couldn't say anything to refute him.

The bodies of the two of them were getting lower and lower, and the power of the space storm around them became more and more powerful.

Space storms pierced through the bodies of Yun Che and Qianye Ying'er, and Qianye Ying'er realized that the front was hazy.

After a while, she fell into a coma.

"Not good."

Yun Che's voice became more solemn.
